# kinde_permission (Resource)

Permissions represent individual access rights that can be assigned to roles. See [documentation](https://docs.kinde.com/kinde-apis/management/#tag/permissions) for more details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "random_string" "suffix" {
  length  = 8
  special = false
  upper   = false
}

locals {
  smoke_suffix = random_string.suffix.result
}

resource "kinde_permission" "example" {
  name        = "ms_${local.smoke_suffix}_basic_permission"
  key         = "ms_${local.smoke_suffix}_basic_permission"
  description = "Basic permission example for manual Terraform smoke testing"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key identifier of the permission
- `name` (String) Name of the permission

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the permission

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the permission
